## Find a dashboard by Guskey level

Rows follow the [Guskey framework](evaluation_plan.qmd). Columns go from least to most detail: the **Summary** is a section of the Ongoing Report, the **Deep dive** is a dedicated dashboard, and **Raw data** is for downloading responses.

::: {.guskey-matrix}

| Level | Summary | Deep dive | Raw data |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Participant perceptions**<br><span class="matrix-note">Session, course, and coaching feedback; NPS</span> | [Ongoing Report §1](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section1) | [Participant Feedback Rollup](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/participant_feedback/)<br>[Individual Feedback](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/individual_feedback/) | |
| **Participant knowledge**<br><span class="matrix-note">Learning assessments</span> | [Ongoing Report §2](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section2) | [Learning Assessments](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/learning_assessments/) | |
| **Participant mindsets**<br><span class="matrix-note">Diagnostic and follow-up educator surveys</span> | [Ongoing Report §3](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section3) | | |
| **Participant practice**<br><span class="matrix-note">IPG classroom observations</span> | [Ongoing Report §4](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section4) | | [IPG Raw Data / Downloads](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ipg_raw_reports/)<br>Sheets: [by site](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1BfXaee-PW-EDegAoKNTNrVIEvGxzeMPt) · [by coach](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/15IW_4hNSFZO-_GFLk3GCNxuO3EfUVLwE) · [by rubric](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fqth9x9wXITqFONJKT_8MGHdyIsWiHCP-dgVLEzRsJs/edit?gid=1191104641#gid=1191104641) |
| **Student learning**<br><span class="matrix-note">Student survey and student work</span> | [Ongoing Report §5](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section5) | [Student Work Graded](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/student_work_graded/) | |

:::

**Tip:** add `&site=` and a site name to any Ongoing Report link to open it already filtered, for example [`...ongoing_report/?section=section1&site=NY_D11`](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ongoing_report/?section=section1&site=NY_D11).
